tests.description: Identify the exact classic ESP32 DevKit pinout, the USB-powered 5V output and 3V3 output. Identify actual pogo and adapter dimensions before soldering. Confirm the four kit pieces fit the selected rows.
Unpowered A1: all six contacts within each column <1Ω; different columns >10MΩ with external links isolated. Inspect pin1 and the NODE header mapping.
Prototype disconnected from A1: measure USB 5V ≤5.25V and 3V3 3.20–3.38V. R_LIMIT is 560Ω ±1%, ≥0.25W. With its output shorted, source current ≤9.5mA; remove short before connecting the kit.

Place fake battery negative C1 / positive C2, 1kΩ resistor C2–C3, LED anode C3 / cathode C4, and kit jumper C4–C1. Prototype J_OUTPUT pin1→A1 J_NODE pin3 and pin2→pin1. No final-power or matrix cable connected.

Compatible factory firmware: GPIO32 LOW/reset makes LED OFF; explicit enable lights LED; disable turns it OFF. Record USB-test-source voltage at C2 under load; it is intentionally unregulated and must not be called the final 5V rail.
Student supply OFF and positive fixed-battery lead unplugged. TEST_A→C4, TEST_B→C1; fit JP_RETURN only during test. Check stimulus current ≤0.34mA and educational contact voltages 0–5.25V.

Calibrate open, a known short and 1kΩ. Measure open stimulus voltage Vs with DMM; infer R=11k×V/(Vs−V), accounting for divider gain and input loading. Known short ≤20Ω; ≥100Ω rejected; 20–100Ω or saturated/unstable readings inconclusive and OFF. Compare inferred short with DMM continuity <1Ω.

Test the actual four-piece scene: correct C4–C1 kit jumper passes; one lifted contact and wrong-node placements fail. Include alternate paths through LED/resistor in calibration; no false pass through a component.

Test the actual four-piece scene: correct C4–C1 kit jumper passes; one lifted contact and wrong-node placements fail. Include alternate paths through LED/resistor in calibration; no false pass through a component.
Simulated camera approval + failed/inconclusive electrical result keeps student supply OFF. Correction requires a fresh electrical test and separate enable request.
Before enable: stimulus OFF, JP_RETURN removed, test leads disconnected, fixed battery lead restored with power off. No automatic enable after a passing test.
Simulated camera approval + failed/inconclusive electrical result keeps student supply OFF. Correction requires a fresh electrical test and separate enable request.

Connect only one OLED at 0x3C to ESP1 FIX_SDA GPIO4 / FIX_SCL GPIO16 using 3.3V logic and removable leads. Use one effective set of pull-ups; continuity fixture must be unplugged when it is not used. Confirm carrier pin labels before power.
OLED displays greeting with educational source OFF. Display unplug/reconnect and reset do not automatically enable the source.
Display position A1, firmware revision, and Desligado/Pronto states. Never substitute a simulated GUI status for an actual hardware observation.
Verify ADS1115 0x48. Sweep P1/P2 within 0–5.25V; compare displayed signed difference with DMM at 0,1,2.5,5V. Error ≤0.10V+5%|reading|, impedance ≥1MΩ, update rate ≥10Hz.
Reverse sense polarity to show a negative difference; do not apply negative absolute contact voltages. P3 remains disconnected and ammeter paths open.

With prototype source and diagnostic probes isolated as specified, compare capsule V(P1)−V(P2) with DMM at zero and the actual limited-source voltage. Error ≤0.10V+5%|reading|; ≥10 updates/s. All node absolute voltages 0–5.25V.

Power OFF before swapping P1/P2 removable measurement leads. Compare signed differential reading with DMM in both orientations; never apply a negative absolute node voltage. P3 and ammeter paths remain disconnected.
Unpowered: every rail >1kΩ to GND after capacitor charging; no accidental node/service connection.
With links open: 5V buck 4.90–5.04V; 3.3V buck 3.20–3.38V. Current-limited 12V supply, 100mA initially.

Independent OV disconnects: sweep 5V/3V3 buck interfaces with consumers isolated; verify actual thresholds and strict contact peak ≤5.25V during a bounded 12V failed-buck step. Test both guards separately before connecting any IC.

Prototype USB positive and 3V3 supply links are removed before connecting final consumer links. Only one educational source may be connected. Inspect all power-board blocks before enabling; the student latch must not be powered as an incomplete circuit.
Supervised factory qualification only: ALIVE is held LOW for startup/reset tests. All consumer links remain open until voltage guards pass. USB removal, held reset and a power cycle leave 5V_EDU OFF.
1kΩ and 470Ω rail loads remain enabled; 330Ω or 100Ω load trips and remains latched. At 10mA: 5V_EDU 4.75–5.25V.
Sweep load: trip threshold must be >10.6mA and ≤12mA; record REF_TRIP and CURRENT_SENSE.

Supervised factory load test only: with power OFF, USB3V3→matrix J_POWER pin9 holds ALIVE high until CP13 watchdog exists. Explicit enable applies the bounded load; reset under overload must not release the latch. Remove the factory ALIVE link or hold it LOW to simulate heartbeat loss and prove OFF. Remove this link permanently at CP13.

Replace any supervised factory ALIVE link with the completed USB-powered hardware watchdog. Send heartbeat ≤100ms; stopping heartbeat or removing USB must switch rail OFF within 350ms and not restart automatically. Record scope timing.
Scope current at a switched 100Ω load: source current cut off within 1ms, including frozen controller. Do not use UART timestamps as timing evidence.

Independent OV disconnects: sweep 5V/3V3 buck interfaces with consumers isolated; verify actual thresholds and strict contact peak ≤5.25V during a bounded 12V failed-buck step. Test both guards separately before connecting any IC.
P3 low ≤0.5V and high ≥3.5V with measured 2mA load. Short to GND and separately to 5.25V: ≤12mA; scope transient and regulator oscillation.
Pulse 0.5/1/10Hz and duty 25/50/75%: frequency ±5%; duty ±5 percentage points; measure at the physical node.
Use a separately documented LED+1kΩ output fixture on P3. Do not connect the fixed battery to P3. OFF/reset/invalid state disables both output relays.
Scope 25%, 50%, 75% duty at a known frequency; error ≤5 percentage points. Frequency 0.5–10Hz ±5%; ≥5ms break-before-make; changing mode first turns output OFF.
Test each selected gate truth table using protected input levels. Require 20ms stable input and ≤100ms output response. Confirm open inputs read LOW.
Record all four AND input combinations using bounded removable links and DMM-confirmed input levels.
Record all four OR input combinations: input ≤1V LOW, ≥3V HIGH; 20ms stability and output response ≤100ms.
Record LOW→HIGH and HIGH→LOW inversion; retain previous state in the input hysteresis band. Reset and invalid configurations leave output OFF.
Set output, remove the set input and verify retained state. Reset clears it. Simultaneous set/reset resolves to zero.
Restart, rail OFF or configuration loss clears memory and leaves output disabled.
Current mode ±0/1/5/10mA: error ≤0.20mA+5%|reading|, ≥10 updates/s; voltage modes must leave ammeter switches open.
INA226 with external 1Ω shunt 0x40 responds. Use a documented series test arrangement and removable leads; do not assume four-column capsule geometry supports every series arrangement.
OFF, voltage or output mode opens both ammeter terminals. Verify leakage ≤10µA with test stimulus disconnected.
Power OFF to change the documented series fixture between 1kΩ and 470Ω. Compare OLED current with DMM; ≤0.20mA+5%|reading| error. Never put the ammeter directly across the supply.
MT supply 10.0–12.6V, digital high ≥3.3V, low ≤0.8V; reset and CS active high.
Sweep all X addresses and Y buses, proving the non-monotonic X address map. Banks share BUS2…BUS7.
Boot/reset/watchdog expiry: all crosspoints open. Disable rail, clear, configure, precheck, then enable; never configure live.
Scope full clear + 22-node configuration ≤50ms at the physical strobe pins; verify Ron at 0/2.5/5V.
Calibrate with 1kΩ 0.1%; distinguish open, short, 220Ω, 1kΩ and diode polarity; resistance error ≤10% after calibration.
Discharge 1000µF initially at 5V to <0.1V in 3s; keep total analog pin current ≤12mA.
Any short, unknown/invalid configuration or stale routing generation prevents rail enable; the precheck itself leaves rail off.
With all power off remove only the fixed battery patch leads; retain every soldered wire. Connect A1 NODE ribbon. In matrix mode no fixed source or fixture stimulus may remain connected.
Show a valid second battery position and corresponding kit arrangement. Invalid topology or stale routing generation cannot enable power.
Repeat CP01 electrical mapping for A2/A3; test NODE00–NODE10 and positions 0/1/2.
Three active capsules meet meter update rates and output timing concurrently; fourth active request refused.
Repeat screen, voltage, pulse, gate, memory, current and leakage tests independently on each new card. Three active capsules meet all update/timing limits.
Repeat the single-position acceptance at A3; exercise all three bank-A capsules concurrently. Every buffer B-side remains local, and every position retains the same mode capabilities.
Repeat module mapping for B1/B2/B3; verify mirrored service order without renumbering holes.
Test NODE00–NODE21 and all six smart positions, any combination of three active; no unintended bank-to-bank connection.
Repeat single-position voltage, output, current, OLED and movement shutdown checks at B2 with unchanged capsule orientation.
Moving a capsule drops rail before configuration; position identity is independent of capsule identity.
Repeat single-position checks at B3; attempt a fourth active capsule and confirm rejection with power OFF.
Pi separately powered: its 5V must not connect to bench 5V. Test all four USB/bench-power combinations for backfeeding.
Verify physical Pi pin mapping and button debounce. Readiness alone does not energize; explicit request is required. Back/reset/restart returns OFF.
Factory Pi demonstration uses explicit supervised approval; production mode remains blocked until NFC/full integration acceptance.
RC522 SPI mode 0, MSB-first, ≤1MHz initial clock: known/unknown/absent tag correctly reported; NFC failure leaves session unapproved.
Known identity, valid lesson and fresh controller ACKs permit a separate explicit enable request. NFC alone never energizes.
Known tag allows the subsequent readiness checks; unknown/absent/error clears approval. Explicit Energizar is still required after a successful tag.
Graph, recognition, predicted current, routing and all active capsule acknowledgements must pass before enable.
USB unplug/reset or missed heartbeat disables rail and smart outputs within 1s; every restart begins OFF.
30-minute repeated lessons with no reset, incorrect route or false trip. Series-circuit tests use explicitly documented removable leads where geometry requires them.

Repeat hardware cutoff ≤1ms, strict transient contact peaks ≤5.25V, 30-minute operation, no backfeed, leakage ≤10µA and every six-position mode. Record oscilloscope readings as text; screenshots remain external.
Verify enclosure inaccessibility, cable strain relief and all purchased-part fit gates. Production release remains pending until actual evidence is recorded.
